[B1] < deviceB | 'key' : K , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'key' : K , ... > $ deviceB 'sendEncryptedText' UserX | (encrypt(FreshR, K)) .
[B1] < UserX | 'msg' : nils , ... > $ deviceB 'sendEncryptedText' UserX | (M)
=> < UserX | 'msg' : M , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'msg' : encrypt(R, K) , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : K , 'owner' : Owners , ...) > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (deviceB ; encrypt(R, K))
=> < UserX | 'msg' : encrypt(R, K) , ... > < cloudA | deviceB : ('key' : K , 'owner' : (Owners , UserX) , ...) > .
[B3] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : (UserX , Owners) , ...) > $ UserX 'resetDevice' cloudA | (deviceB)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : Owners , ...) > .
[B4] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
